'''Reeze Duurmun''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was [[Tobb Jadak]]'s co-pilot during their missions for the [[Republic Group/Legends|Republic Group]] aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Stellar Envoy'']], he was previously known to have flown spice, making the acquaintance of crime boss [[Rej Taunt]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Reeze was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during a mission to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], after being chased by Republic forces the ''Stellar Envoy'' lost all power and collided with the freighter ''[[Jendirian Valley III]]''. Tobb and Reeze made it to an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] and jettisoned. However, power was restored to the ''Stellar Envoy'', which spun immediately, crushing the pod and killing Reeze and putting Jadak in a coma for many years. In what would be a remarkable coincidence, Taunt would end up owning the same ship Reeze had died in.
